blogs.title: From Predictor to Architect: How LLMs are Redefining Feature Engineering
blogs.description: This post explores the paradigm shift proposed by FeatLLM, where Large Language Models act as expert feature engineers rather than just end-point predictors. It explains how the framework leverages the LLM's 'world knowledge' to generate logical rules and new features, transforming raw data into meaningful insights before training a simple model.

blogs.title: The High Cost of AI Inference: How FeatLLM Cuts Costs and Latency
blogs.description: Focusing on the efficiency aspect, this blog post discusses how FeatLLM solves the expensive problem of querying an LLM for every single data sample. It details the advantage of using the LLM only during the feature creation phase, allowing for rapid, low-cost predictions using lightweight models like linear regression at inference time.

blogs.title: Making Sense of Small Data: Solving the 'Cold Start' Problem with LLMs
blogs.description: Targeted at data scientists working with limited labeled data, this article highlights FeatLLM's superior performance in few-shot learning scenarios. It covers how the framework utilizes prior knowledge to outperform traditional methods even with very few training samples, making it highly applicable for specialized industries like healthcare and finance.

blogs.title: Beyond the Black Box: Why Rule-Based Features are the Future of Explainable AI
blogs.description: This post delves into the interpretability benefits of the FeatLLM framework. It explains how generating explicit 'if-then' rules allows practitioners to understand *why* a model made a specific prediction, offering a transparent and trustworthy alternative to the opaque nature of standard deep learning models.
